title: Direct runtime bootstrap must not guess owners
prompt: An automation harness invokes the authenticated runtime agent directly with create-jarvis-skill. JARVIS_HOME, company name and a first-workflow hint are set, but authorized source scope and approval owners are absent. Do not invoke a bootstrap form, invent owners, or ask a broad questionnaire. Probe what is observable, then produce the correct runtime-readable needs-input result with the smallest irreducible questions.
